name: Lily
about: Lily is Gladias and Seila's daughter, who struggles at school and keeps to herself. The book does not describe her appearance, so this look is invented and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: Lily slowly walked out, her eyes looking to the ground.
Sixty percent on the history exam.
Lily took out her hand device, and began intently watching and quickly tapping on the screen
facts.fact: Habitually absorbed in a game on her hand device.

facts.quote: She prefers summer, she doesn't like the cold as much.
unrestricted camera surveillance of our whole country's teenagers to bring our loved ones home
she is in a boarding school
facts.fact: Later attends a boarding school (age-consistent with a young teen).

descriptor: a girl of about thirteen, slight and a little hunched, warm brown skin, long dark-brown hair in a low side ponytail with a heavy fringe falling over her eyes, wearing an oversized heather-grey wrapped poncho-cape with a deep cowl collar and long sleeve cuffs pulled over her hands, dark navy seamless leggings, soft white wrap-around shoes and a glowing hand device held close
sheet_prompt: Character reference sheet on a plain flat off-white background with no scenery: three full-body views of the same person side by side, front view facing the viewer, three-quarter view, and back view, neutral standing pose, even lighting. The person is a girl of about thirteen, slight and a little hunched, warm brown skin, long dark-brown hair in a low side ponytail with a heavy fringe falling over her eyes, wearing an oversized heather-grey wrapped poncho-cape with a deep cowl collar and long sleeve cuffs pulled over her hands, dark navy seamless leggings, soft white wrap-around shoes and a glowing hand device held close.
costume_notes: An oversized cowl-collared poncho-cape keeps her withdrawn, hidden-hands look and grey-navy palette, suits her dislike of the cold, and keeps the hand device she is always gaming on.
